name: Brookside Campground
note: Family campground of 50 years in the woods along a creek at 52482 320th St, Blooming Prairie: 30/50-amp electric-and-water sites $37 Sun-Thu, $47 Fri-Sat (2026), holiday weekends $57 with a 3-night minimum; weekly and monthly rates, primitive tent sites. Request reservations online or by phone. RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude

name: Shooting Star Casino RV Park
note: White Earth Nation's paved RV park beside Shooting Star Casino in Mahnomen - a developed park, not a casino overnight lot: 47 deluxe hookup lots; check in at the hotel front desk. Reservations by phone. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: starcasino.com RV park page read 2026-10-03: 47 paved deluxe lots with electric service, reservations 800-453-7827; RV Life 4* $$ (avg $21) over 28 reviews - passes price on tier; developed casino park per the Sleeping Ute / Downstream precedent

name: Lum Park RV Campground
note: City of Brainerd campground in Lum Park on Rice Lake (1619 NE Washington St): 30/50-amp electric and water sites, free Wi-Fi, fire rings, dump station. Open May 1-Oct 31; $55 a day, $45 for 65+/military/veterans, $25 off-season in October and April (electric only). No tents and no weekly-or-longer seasonal rates. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ci.brainerd.mn.us facility page read 2026-10-03: City of Brainerd RV campground, May 1-Oct 31, standard daily rate $55; Google 'Lum Park' 4.3 over 615 with phone. Local-government campground RV Life tags commercial - local pass miss, no price gate

name: Saginaw Campground
note: Campground at the US 2 / MN 33 roundabout in Saginaw, about 15 miles west of Duluth: sites with water, electric and sewer at $40 weeknights and $45 Friday-Sunday, $275 a week, $575 a month; seasonal sites; tent sites $25-30. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: saginawcampground.com read 2026-10-03: full-hookup sites $40 nightly / $45 weekend nights; RV Life 4* $$ (avg $37) over 25 reviews, Google 4.1 over 99 with phone

name: Hungry Jack Lodge Campground
note: Campground at Hungry Jack Lodge on Hungry Jack Lake, off the Gunflint Trail about 26 miles up from Grand Marais - a base camp for the BWCA: sites with water and 30-amp electric, including spaces for large motorhomes, $40 a night for two (+$8 per extra person). Call to reserve; no online booking for the campground. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: hungryjacklodge.com campground page read 2026-10-03: $40/night for 2, water + 30-amp electric, large motorhome spaces, phone reservations; RV Life 5* $$ (avg $37) over 5 reviews, Google 'Hungry Jack Lodge & Campground' 4.7 over 374

name: Pine Acres Resort & Campground
note: Family resort campground on Orr Bay of Pelican Lake at Orr: about 20 full-hookup sites and 30 lakefront sites with electric, water and docking, $55 a night (lakefront/sewer sites) or $48 (other hookup sites), weekly rates; wooded hilltop sites with electric and water for tents and small campers $26. Shower house; 3-night minimum on holiday weekends. --Claude
